title: Marine storage: mineral pores, pressure-matched gas, thermal and service limits
status_authority: Supplied source-reported engineering model and design screens at exact available capture scope, not an independent Capital model execution or physical audit.
reported_status: The completed available P2 6BD076F4 return specifies a wet-installed mineral pore reservoir with independently supported barrier skins and retrievable machinery. Source-reported integrated engineering models deliver 100 MWh at 1 MW over 100 h after a 144 h hold, importing 154.286 MWh with 1.551 MW peak; startup power remains unverified. The central modeled efficiency is 64.815%, or 65.062% with friction-only gas handling, both physically unqualified. Repeat capital $32.469 million ($324.69/useful kWh) and delivered cost $2,073/MWh at $20 charging ($2,104 at $40) fail the $15/kWh and $125/MWh targets. Wet filling avoids a giant hollow-vessel lift but pays approximately 575,051 tonnes mineral, 225,393 m2 physical skins, foundation preparation and barrier renewal. Granular pores, flexible walls, wet filling and atmospheric snorkel are credited prior art, not a novel demonstrated invention. Actual pressure-conditioned pores, supported seams, collectors, machinery, startup, life and installation productivity remain unqualified; no all-marine impossibility is proved. A separate whole ROOT note develops conditional pressure-compensated gas, useful-rate pressure matching and finite heat/service interfaces. The gas integration is DIFFERENT and unconstructed, not a repair implemented in the pore model. Isothermal gas work pV ln(r) includes pressure displacement; a constant-high-pressure throttled piston is an explicit bad-controller example, not a liquid-piston impossibility. Strong component experiments retain their thermodynamic, single-shot and shallow-pool boundaries. Actual complete gas machinery, reinforced barrier, pressure matching, thermal rate, AC retention, cost and life remain unconstructed.

proof_availability.classification_scope: The whole economical marine invention remains unresolved. Approximately 65% modeled efficiency has little margin and depends on unmeasured hysteresis/gas assumptions. Actual conditioned porosity/permeability/creep, full-pressure moving support/seams/ports, foundation parcel and route, pump/turbine simultaneous curves, subsea reliability, startup transient, barrier life and renewal productivity are not supplied. Friction-only gas accounting is a valid sensitivity rather than proof that central extra gas-column work is unavoidable. Financial horizon is not every component life. Source-reported prototype/literature/supplier scopes do not establish this store; opaque citation identities are not guessed or recovered. Separate pressure fragment and rendered continuation limits remain explicit. All known/unknown access/transfer holds persist; no source, artifact, Library or archive recovery, model replay, procurement or physical experiment. ROOT distinct Ren2024 shallow-bag observation and Wieberdink2018/Ren2019 chamber experiments do not establish deep-field life, whole-path AC efficiency, pressure-matched power train or complete price. No held identity was recovered or released; no SI/cited-original/thesis/provider download was followed. A pressure-matched mean does not remove vertical gradients, buoyancy, membrane tension or service.
